verdict.rationale: Airbyte supports some built-in event-triggered automation—cron/scheduled syncs, webhook/email notifications on connection events, and automatic dbt transformations after a sync completes—but there is no general-purpose rule engine where a user defines arbitrary 'if event X then action Y' logic; automation is limited to fixed sync-triggered notifications/transforms rather than user-defined conditional rules. missing for 10: a documented user-defined rules/conditions engine, custom event-to-action mapping beyond notifications/dbt, and independent evidence of this automation working in practice.
